raw_segments.text: Don John. I had rather be a canker in a hedge than a rose in his grace, and it better fits
my blood to be disdained of all than to fashion a carriage to rob love from any. In this,
though I cannot be said to be a flattering, honest man, it must not be denied but I am
a plain-dealing villain. I am trusted with a muzzle and enfranchised with a clog, therefore
I have decreed not to sing in my cage. If I had my mouth, I would bite. If I had my
liberty, I would do my liking. In the meantime, let me be that I am and seek not to alter
